# Tally — Form Builder Guide

> Tally is a document-style online form builder for creating, publishing, and sharing forms. It offers unlimited forms and submissions on its free plan, subject to fair usage guidelines.

You can try the form builder without an account, but Tally’s terms say an account is required to publish a form.

Tally offers free form-building features alongside Pro and Business features; check pricing for current plan boundaries.

## Start building

- [Get started](<https://tally.so/help/get-started>): An introduction to building forms with Tally’s document-style editor.
- [Create a form](<https://tally.so/help/create-a-form>): Add questions and logic, customize the form, then publish and share it.
- [Form templates](<https://tally.so/templates>): Browse forms to adapt instead of starting from a blank page.
- [Tally AI](<https://tally.so/help/free-ai-form-builder>): Create or edit a form with a plain-language prompt; Tally says it is available on all plans.
- [Import a form](<https://tally.so/help/import>): Bring in a Typeform form or turn supported files into editable draft forms.

## Design questions and form flows

- [Feature overview](<https://tally.so/help/features>): Find help topics for form blocks, logic, customization, settings, and submissions.
- [Input blocks](<https://tally.so/help/input-blocks>): See the question and input types available for collecting responses.
- [Conditional logic](<https://tally.so/help/conditional-form-logic>): Show or hide blocks, skip pages, and tailor paths based on responses.
- [Calculated fields](<https://tally.so/help/form-calculator>): Calculate values such as quiz scores or prices from respondents’ answers.
- [Customize a form](<https://tally.so/help/customize-your-form>): Adjust themes, colors, fonts, images, and layout; some advanced options require Pro.
- [Form settings](<https://tally.so/help/form-settings>): Configure access, completion behavior, notifications, and other form options.

## Share forms and collect responses

- [Embed a form](<https://tally.so/help/embed-your-form>): Use standard, popup, or full-page embeds on a website.
- [File uploads](<https://tally.so/help/file-uploads>): Collect respondent files; the free plan has a 10 MB per-file limit.
- [Payment forms](<https://tally.so/help/payment-forms>): Collect credit card payments through Stripe; standard Stripe fees apply.
- [Name form fields](<https://tally.so/help/how-to-name-fields>): Make question titles and submission columns easier to identify.

## Plans, support, and policies

- [Pricing](<https://tally.so/pricing>): Compare free, Pro, and Business features and review fair-usage limits.
- [Help center](<https://tally.so/help>): Browse Tally’s guides on building forms, features, integrations, and billing.
- [Privacy policy](<https://tally.so/privacy>): Read how Tally describes its handling of personal data and user rights.
- [Terms and conditions](<https://tally.so/terms>): Review account, use, and subscription terms.

# Tally Help Center

> Practical guides for creating, publishing, and improving Tally forms, from a first form to conditional workflows, integrations, and troubleshooting.

Start with form creation, then use the feature and settings guides for specific questions. Plan availability varies by feature; consult the plan and fair-use pages when limits matter.

## Create your first form

- [Create a form](<https://tally.so/help/create-a-form>): Add questions and logic, customize the form, then publish and share it.
- [Input blocks](<https://tally.so/help/input-blocks>): Choose question types for text, choices, dates, files, payments, and more.
- [Form templates](<https://tally.so/help/form-templates>): Start from a template or make a reusable one for your team or the public.
- [Multi-page forms](<https://tally.so/help/how-to-create-a-multi-step-form>): Add page breaks and choose between one question or several questions per page.
- [Customize your form](<https://tally.so/help/customize-your-form>): Adjust themes, fonts, colors, layout, images, and text formatting.

## Build smarter form flows

- [Conditional logic](<https://tally.so/help/conditional-form-logic>): Show or hide blocks, skip pages, calculate values, and troubleshoot branching rules.
- [Calculated fields](<https://tally.so/help/form-calculator>): Work with scores, prices, and formulas; includes checks for incorrect results.
- [Hidden fields](<https://tally.so/help/hidden-fields>): Pass URL parameters into a form for tracking, personalization, or prefilling.
- [Answer piping](<https://tally.so/help/answer-piping>): Insert earlier answers into later questions, text, or a Thank You page.
- [Thank You pages](<https://tally.so/help/how-to-create-a-thank-you-page>): Customize the post-submission message or route respondents to different pages.

## Publish, share, and configure

- [Form settings](<https://tally.so/help/form-settings>): Configure access, notifications, language, respondent behavior, and submission settings.
- [Embed a form](<https://tally.so/help/embed-your-form>): Add a standard, popup, or full-page embed to a website.
- [Redirect on completion](<https://tally.so/help/redirect-on-completion>): Send respondents to another URL after submission, including redirects based on form data.
- [Email notifications](<https://tally.so/help/email-notifications>): Set up submission emails for form owners or respondents.
- [Prevent duplicate submissions](<https://tally.so/help/prevent-duplicate-submissions>): Choose a field to identify repeat submissions and understand the method’s limitations.
- [Build accessible forms](<https://tally.so/help/accessibility>): Review keyboard and screen-reader support, known gaps, and form-writing tips.

## Connect tools and work with responses

- [Integrations overview](<https://tally.so/help/integrations>): Find direct integrations, automation tools, webhooks, embeds, and developer options.
- [Google Sheets integration](<https://tally.so/help/google-sheets-integration>): Sync submissions to a spreadsheet and check delivery logs when entries are missing.
- [Notion integration](<https://tally.so/help/notion-integration>): Map form fields to database properties and troubleshoot missing databases or failed syncs.
- [Webhooks](<https://tally.so/help/webhooks>): Send new-submission data to an endpoint and inspect delivery events.
- [Tally API](<https://tally.so/help/api>): Programmatically manage forms and submissions; covers authentication, versioning, and rate limits.
- [Form insights](<https://tally.so/help/form-insights>): Interpret response charts and visit metrics; check plan restrictions for history and drop-off insights.

## Troubleshoot and manage data

- [Frequently asked questions](<https://tally.so/help/faq>): Answers on page breaks, saved answers, exports, embeds, and common account questions.
- [Delete and recover form data](<https://tally.so/help/how-to-delete-and-recover-form-data>): Restore deleted forms or submissions from Trash within 90 days, unless permanently removed.
- [Form version history](<https://tally.so/help/form-version-history>): Restore an earlier version and publish it to update an already-live form.
- [Plans and pricing](<https://tally.so/help/plans-and-pricing>): Check which needs call for Tally Pro or Business rather than the free plan.
- [Fair Use Policy](<https://tally.so/help/fair-use-policy>): Review the usage patterns that may prompt Tally to discuss a custom plan.

# Tally — form builder guide

> Tally is a document-style online form builder for creating, publishing, and sharing forms. Tally says unlimited forms and submissions are free within its fair usage guidelines; some features require Pro or Business.

You can explore the builder without signing up, but Tally’s terms say an account is required to publish a form.

## Get started

- [Create a form](<https://tally.so/help/create-a-form>): Start with the document-style editor, add questions, and publish and share a form.
- [Form templates](<https://tally.so/templates>): Browse ready-made forms to customize instead of starting from a blank page.
- [Import an existing form](<https://tally.so/help/import>): Bring in a Typeform form or upload a file to create an editable draft.
- [Create with Tally AI](<https://tally.so/help/free-ai-form-builder>): Use a plain-language prompt to build or edit a form in the editor; Tally says this is available on every plan.
- [Help center](<https://tally.so/help>): Find Tally’s guides on form building, features, integrations, and account help.

## Build and customize

- [Feature overview](<https://tally.so/help/features>): Browse Tally’s form inputs, logic, customization, settings, and submission features.
- [Input blocks](<https://tally.so/help/input-blocks>): Choose fields for text, choices, dates, files, payments, and other responses.
- [Conditional logic](<https://tally.so/help/conditional-form-logic>): Show or hide blocks, skip pages, and change a form’s path based on answers.
- [Calculated fields](<https://tally.so/help/form-calculator>): Calculate values such as quiz scores or prices from respondents’ answers.
- [Customize a form](<https://tally.so/help/customize-your-form>): Adjust themes, colors, fonts, layout, and images; check plan requirements for advanced options such as custom CSS.
- [Form settings](<https://tally.so/help/form-settings>): Configure options including access, notifications, closing a form, and respondent behavior.

## Share and collect responses

- [Embed a form](<https://tally.so/help/embed-your-form>): Add a published form to a webpage as a standard, popup, or full-page embed.
- [File uploads](<https://tally.so/help/file-uploads>): Collect files without requiring respondents to sign in; the free plan has a 10 MB per-file limit.
- [Payment forms](<https://tally.so/help/payment-forms>): Collect credit card payments through Stripe; standard Stripe fees apply.
- [Delete and recover form data](<https://tally.so/help/how-to-delete-and-recover-form-data>): Learn how Trash and its 90-day recovery window work for forms, submissions, and workspaces.

## Plans and policies

- [Pricing and plan features](<https://tally.so/pricing>): Compare free access with Pro and Business features, and check current pricing and fair-use conditions.
- [Privacy policy](<https://tally.so/privacy>): Read how Tally says it processes personal data and handles data rights and retention.
- [Terms and conditions](<https://tally.so/terms>): Review the terms governing use of the form builder and paid subscriptions.
